This module provides a high-performance, thread-safe Least Recently Used (LRU) cache
that supports configurable Time-To-Live (TTL) expiration for cached items. It is designed
to handle high-concurrency scenarios using Python's standard library threading primitives.

Features:
- LRU eviction policy when the cache reaches capacity.
- Per-item TTL configuration (items expire after a specific duration).
- Global TTL configuration (fallback if per-item TTL is not set).
- Thread-safe operations (get, set, delete, clear, stats).
- Automatic cleanup of expired entries (lazy and eager modes).
- Detailed statistics tracking (hits, misses, evictions, expirations).
- Support for custom key types and values (hashable keys, pickleable values).
- Context manager support for resource management.
- Serialization/Deserialization support for persistence (optional).
